prompt.en: Thousands of miners came to which part of Canada during the Gold Rush of the 1890s?
prompt.fr: Des milliers de mineurs sont venus dans quelle partie du Canada pendant la ruée vers l'or des années 1890?

explanation.en: The Gold Rush of the 1890s brought thousands of miners to the Yukon. The poet Robert W. Service wrote about those days.
explanation.fr: La ruée vers l'or des années 1890 a amené des milliers de mineurs au Yukon. Le poète Robert W. Service a chanté cette époque.

source.quote: Thousands of miners came to the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s, as celebrated in the poetry of Robert W. Service.

verification.evidence: Thousands of miners came to the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s, as celebrated in the poetry of Robert W. Service. Mining remains a significant part of the economy.
